proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for wireshark, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the wireshark service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the wireshark
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  wireshark:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.wireshark.loadbalancer.server.port=3001
      - traefik.http.services.wireshark.loadbalancer.server.scheme=https
      # The app serves a self-signed certificate: define a serversTransport with insecureSkipVerify: true
      # in Traefik's file provider (named insecure here) and reference it.
      - traefik.http.services.wireshark.loadbalancer.serverstransport=insecure@file
      - traefik.http.routers.wireshark.rule=Host(`wireshark.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.wireshark.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.wireshark.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.wireshark.service=wireshark
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.wireshark.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.wireshark.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Wireshark: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-wireshark/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - capability NET_ADMIN: Required to allow packet capture..
#   - network: host networking is required; hostNetwork is set and no Service is emitted.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: wireshark-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: wireshark
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: wireshark-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: wireshark
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wireshark
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: wireshark
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: wireshark
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: wireshark
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: wireshark
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/wireshark:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: wireshark-env
        volumeMounts:
        - name: wireshark-config
          mountPath: /config
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            add:
            - NET_ADMIN
      hostNetwork: true
      volumes:
      - name: wireshark-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: wireshark-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
quadlet:
# wireshark.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-wireshark/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Wireshark (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/wireshark:latest
ContainerName=wireshark
AutoUpdate=registry
Network=host
AddCapability=NET_ADMIN
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Volume=/path/to/wireshark/config:/config:Z
ShmSize=1gb

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
